record.question: He took ages ____ the job.
record.explanation: Answer A: over. The idiom is “take ages over a job”: spend a long time doing it (A). Independent check: “Take ages over a job” means take a long time doing it. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/take-ages; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/idiom; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses.
